answer: Ambient radio attestation deters Sybil agents by measuring local electromagnetic noise. Verifiers challenge nodes to log the phase ripple of ambient broadcasts. Whether stationed at a coastal jetty or an inland orchard, each host captures a distinct spectrum. Multiplexing personas onto one machine clones this profile, forcing attackers to incur dedicated transceivers and physical sites per identity. However, localized shielding can distort readings, falsely penalizing legitimate agents.
